name: activate_skill
description: Add a skill by name to the active skill set: its prompt and tools merge into the current turn (multiple skills allowed; the first is primary). Activate only when a listed skill clearly and materially improves the user's task — never for generic work, loose keyword overlap, or routine code/file/terminal investigation alone. Use `list_skills` to find candidates when a concrete specialized need exists or the user asks. Scoped to the current turn; unloads automatically.

name.description: Exact name of the skill to activate.
